title: Broad exception caught at 2 sites (L513,L592)
detail: `except Exception` without re-raise swallows unexpected errors silently. Suggested fix: catch only known exception types from the callee.

title: getattr() with constant attribute name at L253
detail: Using `getattr(obj, 'literal_name')` provides no safety benefit over direct attribute access `obj.literal_name`. It misleads readers into thinking the attribute name is dynamic. Suggested fix: use direct attribute access.
